segments.text: Then Job answered:
“I have heard many things like these; miserable comforters are you all.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: Is there no end to your long-winded speeches? What provokes you to continue testifying?
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: I could also speak like you if you were in my place; I could heap up words against you and shake my head at you.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: But I would encourage you with my mouth, and the consolation of my lips would bring relief.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: Even if I speak, my pain is not relieved, and if I hold back, how will it go away?
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: Surely He has now exhausted me; You have devastated all my family.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: You have bound me, and it has become a witness; my frailty rises up and testifies against me.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text:
His anger has torn me and opposed me; He gnashes His teeth at me.
My adversary pierces me with His eyes.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text:
They open their mouths against me and strike my cheeks with contempt;
they join together against me.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: God has delivered me to unjust men; He has thrown me to the clutches of the wicked.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: I was at ease, but He shattered me; He seized me by the neck and crushed me. He has set me up as His target;
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: His archers surround me. He pierces my kidneys without mercy and spills my gall on the ground.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: He breaks me with wound upon wound; He rushes me like a mighty warrior.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: I have sewn sackcloth over my skin; I have buried my horn in the dust.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: My face is red with weeping, and deep shadows ring my eyes;
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: yet my hands are free of violence and my prayer is pure.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: O earth, do not cover my blood; may my cry for help never be laid to rest.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: Even now my witness is in heaven, and my advocate is on high.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: My friends are my scoffers as my eyes pour out tears to God.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: Oh, that a man might plead with God as he pleads with his neighbor!
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: For when only a few years are past I will go the way of no return.
segments.speaker: Job
